$comment: Every native dependency of the root package.json, classified for PulseKit (the embed plan's §4.2 rule 7). `included` packages are listed in embed/package.json, so PulseKit links them; `excluded` ones are not, and the embed bundle must not contain them (Metro stubs the ones shared code still imports: embed/metro.config.js). `npm run check:embed` fails on an unclassified native dependency and on any disagreement with embed/package.json.

included.@expo/ui: Native menus, sheets and tips in the recorder and editor.
included.@shopify/react-native-skia: The editor's timeline and waveform drawing.
included.expo: The Expo runtime PulseKit hosts the Pulse JS in.
included.expo-application: Listed in embed/package.json; the embed's JS doesn't import it today (only deferred pairing, which is standalone-only, does).
included.expo-asset: Bundled assets (fonts, images) in the release bundle.
included.expo-audio: Audio focus in the recorder and preview audio in the editor.
included.expo-brownfield: Builds PulseKit and carries the JS-to-native messaging the facade uses.
included.expo-build-properties: Config plugin only (Android minSdk 29, whisper.rn's ProGuard keep rule); no native code.
included.expo-constants: App config at run time; required by the Expo runtime.
included.expo-crypto: Random UUIDs for drafts, destinations and upload ids.
included.expo-device: Device class for picking the on-device captions model.
included.expo-file-system: Drafts, clips and exports on disk under the host's storage roots.
included.expo-font: Fonts the UI loads (Material Symbols on Android).
included.expo-glass-effect: Glass pills and toasts on iOS 26.
included.expo-image: Thumbnails in the recorder's segment bar.
included.expo-image-picker: Adding clips from the photo library in the recorder.
included.expo-localization: Locale and time zone for date labels.
included.expo-media-library: Save to Photos on Export and library access for imports (Q6).
included.expo-secure-store: Upload destination tokens in the keychain.
included.expo-sqlite: pulse.db, opened only by Pulse JS (§4.2 rule 6).
included.expo-symbols: SF Symbols in the recorder and menus.
included.expo-system-ui: Applies app.json's interface style and root background natively; no JS import.
included.expo-video: Playback in the editor and export preview.
included.react-native-nitro-modules: Nitro runtime for pulse-editor and VisionCamera.
included.react-native-reanimated: Animations that show state and follow a finger.
included.react-native-safe-area-context: Safe-area insets inside the container view controller.
included.react-native-screens: The embed's FlowStack (N3) is a native screen stack.
included.react-native-zip-archive: Linked today; only .pulse transfer and library backup use it, which the embed hides.
included.whisper.rn: On-device captions; the model downloads into the host's storage root (F5).

excluded.@react-native-async-storage/async-storag: Only the legacy one-time move into SQLite read it, which an embedded library never had (B6).
excluded.expo-clipboard: Pairing, About and the app's upload link only (B6).
excluded.expo-document-picker: .pulse import and library restore only, both hidden in the embed (B6, PR1-L).
excluded.expo-linking: The host app owns incoming links; the embed opens URLs through React Native's Linking.
excluded.expo-router: The embed's FlowStack replaces the router; routes live in the standalone shell.
excluded.expo-splash-screen: The host app owns launch; the container shows its own skeleton.
excluded.expo-status-bar: The status-bar port talks to the container view controller instead (AD22).
excluded.expo-web-browser: A config plugin of the Pulse app (app.json); no code imports it.
excluded.react-native-background-actions: Its Android service assumes a React Native host app and crashes in others.
excluded.react-native-nitro-screen-recorder: Screen recording is standalone-only: it needs the Pulse app's broadcast extension (iOS) and screen-capture service (Android).
